operator-walkthrough.ref: Admin UI v1 Wave 5, what the crew sees on an iPhone after this merges, in the Reach, Machine and System sections of nickstire.org/admin. A failed read no longer shows a confident zero, 'none' or an empty sentence: Growth's Social Pipeline Health and Review Replies, Settings' ALG status and its Customers and Website leads tiles, Declined recovery, Traffic to Revenue's top booking pages and GSC audit, Market intelligence, the Content row (Total Articles, Published, Drafts, AI Generations) and the Ops Hub live checks each say the read failed or is unknown, with Retry where a refetch exists; a read paused because the phone is offline says 'Offline, not checked' in Settings and 'Meta unknown' on Instagram. Every Retry button is a 48 px target. On Customer intelligence the VIP rows' Call and Text are real tel: and sms: links (no message text is pre-filled), 48 px and always visible, and absent when the row has no phone; there were buttons there before that did nothing and only appeared on hover. The Reports tab no longer lists repository file paths a phone cannot open. Each section has one horizontally scrolling tab strip with 48 px tabs and the daily tabs first: Outreach opens on Messages then Follow-Ups, Reviews, Win-Back; Growth opens on Review Replies, the only tab with a daily backlog; Instagram's five main views scroll instead of squeezing into a fixed five-column grid, with the other seven still under More surfaces; Integrations, SMS Orchestrator and Database hygiene use the same strip. Labels in Settings and Integrations are sentence case. Deep links (?outreachTab, ?growthTab, ?settingsTab, ?tab, ?igview) resolve as before. Customer-facing text is unchanged (admin-customer-copy-pins green). The unused AdminAlertBar component is deleted. Tests: client/src/__tests__/admin-w5-honesty, admin-w5-controls, admin-w5-strips, admin-w5-round1; 143 client files / 1,991 tests green on the combined tree. Not device-tested: Nour's own look on his phone is owed after the deploy.
